projects.title: 24 Game
projects.description: We implemented the 24 Game (www.24game.com) on a Nexys 3 FPGA Board in Verilog. The game utilizes the board's various hardware components as inputs and outputs. For example, the switches are used to select numbers that are displayed on the seven-segment displays. This electronic version of the game provides a new and exciting way to practice math alone or with friends.

projects.title: QuickPitch
projects.description: QuickPitch is a mobile Android application for investors and entrepreneurs to connect. The app allows users to either sign up as entrepreneurs or investors. Entrepreneurs can upload a quick pitch video about a product or company. Investors have access to a feed of the entrepreneurs' videos that allows them pass quick judgement on whether or not they are interested. With the backend implemented in Java, the front-end was developed using AndroidStudio. A mySQL database is used to store login credentials.
